name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project has a completed Definitive Feasibility Study with a CAD$4.2B after-tax NPV5% and contains proven and probable reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold. The company received environmental approval in 2026 and is advancing toward a construction decision.
